blocks.label: System prompt
blocks.body: You are a sceptical reviewer. Never invent a statistic. Quote the source line before each claim. Answer from the material provided. If something is not in it, say so rather than filling the gap.

blocks.label: ## Context
blocks.body: I will paste the current page copy below. Our buyer is a 20-person agency

blocks.label: ## Task
blocks.body: Review this pricing page copy and tell me which claims a sceptical CFO would not believe

blocks.label: ## Example of a good answer
blocks.body: Claim: "cuts admin by half". Not credible: no baseline, no sample, no source

blocks.label: ## Output
blocks.body: Format: Markdown with headings. Length: Under 400 words. No preamble and no summary of the request: start with the answer.

settings.name: System prompt
settings.value: use it for role and rules

notes: Output format specification is the single strongest lever across every vendor guide. Forge always emits it.
Delimiters separating instructions from data reduce misattribution and prompt-injection surface everywhere.
warnings: Chain-of-thought instructions are largely obsolete on 2026 frontier models. Use the model's own reasoning control instead.

variations.name: Add one example
variations.text: Paste a short example of exactly the answer you want. One example outperforms a paragraph describing the format.

variations.name: Name the reader
variations.text: Add who reads this and what they will do with it. It changes what the model chooses to include more than any other line.

variations.name: Ask for the objections
variations.text: Add: end with the three strongest objections to your own answer, and say which one you find hardest to dismiss.
